req.title: Return GET request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /get with a JSON object containing the request's URL, headers, arguments, and origin IP.
expected_outcomes: JSON body with keys url, args, headers, origin
error_pathways: HTTP 405 if a non-GET method is used

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /get returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys 'url', 'args', 'headers', and 'origin'. Non-GET methods must return HTTP 405. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – plain GET returns 200 with all four required keys present and non-null; (2) negative NEG – POST to /get returns 405 (method not allowed); (3) boundary BVA – GET with query parameters verifies 'args' key reflects the exact query string values; (4) DT – verifying each of the four required keys individually with exact type assertions to catch key-deletion mutations; (5) NEG – verifying that the response body does NOT contain keys outside the contract (e.g. 'form', 'data') to catch mutations that add extra keys from get_dict.

tests.name: test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No special headers or query parameters are set
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Issue GET /get with no query parameters
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200
Response Content-Type contains application/json
JSON body contains exactly the keys: url, args, headers, origin
Value of 'args' is an empty dict (no query params sent)
Value of 'url' is a non-empty string
Value of 'origin' is a non-empty string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: Expected outcomes: JSON body with keys url, args, headers, origin; HTTP 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert data['args'] == {}
    assert isinstance(data['url'], str) and len(data['url']) > 0
    assert isinstance(data['origin'], str) and len(data['origin']) > 0
    assert isinstance(data['headers'], dict)

tests.name: test_get_headers_reflected_in_response
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Issue GET /get with a custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel-value
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200
JSON body key 'headers' is a dict
The custom header 'X-Test-Header' with value 'sentinel-value' appears in the 'headers' dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: JSON body with key headers containing the request's HTTP headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_headers_reflected_in_response():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in data['headers'].items()}
    assert 'x-test-header' in headers_lower
    assert headers_lower['x-test-header'] == 'sentinel-value'

client = app.test_client()

def test_get_url_field_contains_get_path():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data['url'], str)
    assert '/get' in data['url']
    assert data['url'] != ''
    assert data['origin'] is not None

    assert data['origin'] != ''
